comment: Menu item names read from the maker's source at commit 0441118, which is what the installed 2.1.6 build matches. The two Switching order choices are printed with arrows between the words; the lines say then instead, because the lines are spoken. Looper and Looper Two carry the same menu apart from Add feedback expander, which is Looper's alone. The Feedback Expander, Lopper and Loop Mutator have no menu of their own. Format, Bit depth and Polyphony are labels inside File settings, not items.
